title: Voice Chat with Whisper, Bark and WebRTC
summary: Karim Lalani turns a LangChain chain into a talking agent with WebRTC, Whisper and Bark.
learn: WebRTC streams media between browser and server, and a server can act as a peer.
Whisper runs locally for transcription; Suno Bark does text to audio, which is more expressive than plain text to speech.
The LangChain part is a small chain, so you can swap in a RAG app or an agent behind it.
To play audio back live, the server has to inject new audio into a running track at the right timestamp.
Transcription and synthesis live in separate modules, so either one can be swapped out.
